title: Plugin and module version management
summary: Admins can now see the version of every module and plugin, and when each was last updated.
changes: Add an Admin Versions page listing every module and plugin with its installed and code version.
Each deploy records version changes, so an upgraded plugin shows Update applied with the date.
Show the recent version history for each module and plugin.
version_rationale: Patch: adds two version-tracking tables and a read-only admin page; no existing data changes.
validation: New feature test for the versions page, recording an upgrade and repeat syncs.
Module, navigation, admin route denial, seeder and architecture tests.
Full PHPUnit suite and the MySQL contract job in CI.
known_limitations: Plugins can only come from the code repository; there is no install from outside.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new tables can stay; earlier releases ignore them.
provenance: Milestone v0.48.3 Beta, issue #473 under epic #470, pull request #600.
